scenarios.name: normal_minimum_ventilation
scenarios.description: OAF 0.18 against a 0.30 alarm point (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 18.4 °C) — design minimum plus the spread a real damper holds

scenarios.name: excess_outdoor_air
scenarios.description: OAF 0.40 (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 14.0 °C) — 0.25 above design, so 0.10 past the margin; alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: summer_excess_oat_above_rat
scenarios.description: Sign case: outdoor air warmer than return (oat 35 °C, rat 24 °C, mat 28.4 °C) — both differences flip sign, the quotient still reads 0.40, and the rule alarms exactly as it does in winter

scenarios.name: small_delta_not_evaluable
scenarios.description: NO_EVAL with the gate doing work: |oat − rat| = 2 °C (oat 20 °C, rat 22 °C) and mat 21 °C, so the raw fraction reads 0.50 and marginHigh is true — an ungated rule would alarm; yTempDeltaOk stays false and holds yFault down

scenarios.name: delta_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: |oat − rat| = 6.0 °C exactly (oat 16 °C, rat 22 °C) with OAF 0.50 (mat 19 °C) — the strict `>` leaves the rule not evaluable, so a fraction well past the alarm point still reports NO_EVAL

scenarios.name: delta_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: |oat − rat| = 6.5 °C (oat 15.5 °C, rat 22 °C) with OAF 0.40 (mat 19.4 °C) — evaluable, and the excess alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: margin_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAF 0.30 exactly (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 16 °C), so the margin equals oa_excess_margin — the strict `>` means no fault

scenarios.name: margin_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: OAF 0.31 (mat 15.8 °C) clears the strict comparison by one hundredth and alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: transient_excess_clears_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: OAF jumps to 0.40 at t=600 and falls back to 0.18 at t=1800 — 1200 s of excess, short of alarm_delay, so the damper stroke never becomes an alarm

scenarios.name: recovery_clears_alarm
scenarios.description: Recovery: OAF 0.40 alarms after alarm_delay, then the damper returns to minimum at t=3000 (OAF 0.18) — yFault drops on that tick, with no hold-off
